modelImplementation.status: integrated original Three.js geometry library; VAB thumbnails and craft meshes use the same model factory
modelImplementation.sourcePolicy: All models are independently authored primitive/mesh assemblies. No extracted KSP stock/DLC meshes, textures, logos, or game files are redistributed.
modelImplementation.coverage: Distinct geometry branches for command pods, probe cores, tanks/fuselages/resources, engines/jet engines/solid boosters, wings/tail/control surfaces, solar arrays, parachutes, batteries, communications, science instruments, decouplers/structural parts, docking ports, payloads, thermal parts, intakes, landing gear, utility parts, robotics and rotor blades. Several families also have per-ID/name variants.
modelImplementation.limitations: These are original KSP-inspired approximations, not exact reproductions of official KSP models. Per-part mesh dimensions, attachment nodes, collision shapes and articulation still require refinement.
